short: A family of American fifth-generation stealth multirole fighters designed for network-centric warfare.
full:
The Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II entered service in July 2015, resulting from the Joint Strike Fighter program meant to replace multiple aging aircraft types across the US military and allied nations. It was developed in three main variants: conventional takeoff, short takeoff and vertical landing, and carrier-based. The F-35 features unprecedented sensor fusion and data-sharing capabilities, allowing it to act as an airborne battle manager.

Despite a protracted and highly scrutinized development process that made it the most expensive military weapons system in history, the F-35 has proliferated widely among NATO and allied air forces. It represents a fundamental shift in aerial warfare, prioritizing situational awareness, electronic warfare, and low observability over traditional kinematic performance.
